note: Pre-registered before any lever result was computed. Never edit after a run; supersede with bl054_criteria_addendum_N.json naming what it replaces.
strategies: the 11 of bl053_criteria.json: the 10 named configs (every rebalance phase blended) and the frozen Phase 6 ensemble

settings.space: search_spaces/round7_A.toml fixed settings, except capital 500000 (the owner's slice)
settings.tax: after tax, TaxRules() defaults: 30% slab + 4% cess, STCG 20%, LTCG 12.5% past 365 days; pre-tax shown alongside

windows.development: FY2018-FY2022 (2017-04-01 to 2022-03-31): every pass rule is judged here
windows.confirmation: FY2023-FY2026 (2022-04-01 to 2026-03-31): read once per lever, only for levers that pass development; a lever is adopted only if its development pass holds there too (same direction, see per-lever rule)
windows.note: windows are slices of one continuous curve (the engine runs the whole span once); the stop and sizing levers act identically whichever window is read

common_pass.less_pain: Ulcer index AND max drawdown both shallower than the baseline's in at least 7 of the 11 strategies, in the window
common_pass.return_floor: median over the 11 of (lever CAGR - baseline CAGR) >= -0.02, after tax
common_pass.bad_years: median third-worst FY excess over Nifty200 Momentum 30 TRI >= the baseline's median (development: FY2018-FY2022, so this is the second-worst of five)
common_pass.timing: where a lever sells between rebalances, it is run at both fill timings (stop_delay 0 and 1 for weekly; next day's open is the only timing for daily) and must pass at both

L1_cadence_tax.question: does trading less often, and holding a gain to long-term, raise the after-tax return?
L1_cadence_tax.cells: rebalance_every in [4, 6, 8, 13] x tax_hold in [off, band 2 / 8 weeks]; every phase blended; the ensemble's sleeves at the same cadences on their frozen offsets mod the cadence
L1_cadence_tax.baseline: each strategy's own cadence (2 or 4), tax_hold off
L1_cadence_tax.pass: median after-tax CAGR change >= +0.015 AND the median Ulcer change <= +0.01 AND after-tax CAGR not lower in at least 7 of 11
L1_cadence_tax.confirm: median after-tax CAGR change >= 0 on FY2023-FY2026
L1_cadence_tax.adopt: the slowest cadence that passes both; tax_hold only if it passes on its own at that cadence

L2_phase_blend.question: how much does trading on all rebalance Fridays at once (equal tranches) change the ensemble and each config?
L2_phase_blend.cells: report only: own phase vs all phases blended, each of the 11, pre- and after-tax; no pass rule - adoption is a live-trading decision

L3_etf_blend.question: does holding part of the money in the ETF rotation lower the falls for little return?
L3_etf_blend.cells: Broad share in [1.0, 0.75, 0.5] with the ETF 'filter' strategy (data/backtests/compare.xlsx equity sheet, pre-tax, rebalanced to target weights at each April reset), from stored curves; pre-tax only (the ETF curve has no after-tax series)

L4_daily_stop.question: the owner's rule: every evening check each holding's close; if it is X below the buy price or Y below its peak, sell at the next morning's open; hold cash until the next rebalance
L4_daily_stop.cells: stop_from_buy in [off, 0.20, 0.25] x stop_from_peak in [off, 0.25, 0.30], both-off excluded: 8 cells; proceeds cash; fill at the next session's open (open / exchange prevclose on the engine's running price); a day with a lower-circuit lock blocks the sale
L4_daily_stop.daily_data: bars_1d_stock EQ series; daily move = close / prevclose - 1 (the exchange adjusts prevclose for corporate actions); the running price is the engine's weekly fill price compounded by those moves; the peak is the highest daily close since the first buy
L4_daily_stop.pass: common_pass (less_pain, return_floor, bad_years) after tax, on development
L4_daily_stop.confirm: less_pain holds (>= 6 of 11) on FY2023-FY2026 and return_floor holds there

L5_inverse_vol.question: does sizing each pick by the inverse of its 26-week realised volatility (instead of equal shares) lower the falls?
L5_inverse_vol.cells: weight_by in [equal, inverse_vol]; inverse_vol: shares of each buy week's money proportional to 1 / trailing 26-week weekly-return std, normalised across the names bought that week, then the position cap as today
L5_inverse_vol.confirm: less_pain holds (>= 6 of 11) on FY2023-FY2026 and return_floor holds there

L6_residual_momentum.question: does ranking stocks on momentum left after removing the market and the sector move keep the return with smaller falls?
L6_residual_momentum.cells: score in [as searched, residual]; residual: regress each stock's weekly return on Nifty 50 TRI and its category's equal-weight return over the trailing 52 weeks (point in time), rank on the sum of the last 26 weekly residuals divided by their std (skip the latest 4 weeks); everything else as the config
L6_residual_momentum.confirm: less_pain holds (>= 6 of 11) on FY2023-FY2026 and return_floor holds there
L6_residual_momentum.status: built last; may run after the others are reported

trial_count: cells x timings across every lever here (about 22 cells, 30 cell-timings) are added to the BL-010 trial log; no cell is read as evidence on its own
will_not_run: finer grids or other thresholds than listed
combinations of levers (a passing lever is adopted one at a time; a combination needs a new addendum)
any change to the live weekly signal (adoption is a separate item)
